content: <thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528. In positive mode this is most plausibly the [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral mass of ≈120.045 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1) suggests a molecule containing about eight carbon atoms. The simplest formula matching this mass and carbon count is C₈H₈O, which corresponds to a neutral exact mass of 120.0575 Da – within the typical experimental tolerance for a single measurement. Therefore the molecular formula of the analyzed compound is C₈H₈O.
